latest_events.title: Mali: 54 dead bodies discovered in a camp, EIGs implicated
latest_events.summary: A massacre of civilian populations was reported in the region of Menaka, Mali. Fifty-four dead bodies were discovered in a camp located about 35 kilometers southeast of the city. The Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (EIGs) is implicated in these killings, according to the first testimonies collected by the Malian army In a statement seen by Seneweb, the General Staff of the Armed Forces indicates that a joint patrol of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners was deployed on the ground after reports of a terrorist attack against civilian populations in the operational sub-sector of Menaka.

latest_events.title: Swiss and Austrian women in Libya after release from Niger kidnap ordeal
latest_events.summary: An Austrian and a Swiss women kidnapped in Niger more than a year and a half ago have been freed and are in Libya, Bern and Vienna announced Thursday. Sixty-nine-year-old Swiss national Claudia Abbt and 76-year-old Eva Gretzmacher arrived in the eastern city of Benghazi where they received medical treatment. Their release follows an intervention by Libyan military commander Khalifa Haftar, who controls the east and parts of the south of the country.

latest_events.title: More than 40 civilians killed in armed attack in northeast Mali
latest_events.summary: More than 40 civilians have been killed in attacks by militants on camps in Mali's northeastern Menaka region, AFP quoted security and local sources as saying. The sources reported that the attackers used motorcycles to reach camps inhabited mostly by members of the Dussaq tribe, whose executive body accused the Islamic State of being behind the killings. According to the sources, the Dussac tribe is the cradle of the armed “Movement for the Salvation of Azawad”, allied with the government, in Bamako.

latest_events.title: Report: 'Indiscriminate' drone strikes by Malian and Russian 'Africa Corps' forces
latest_events.summary: Summary Data from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project, a US-based conflict observatory, showed that Malian and Africa Corps forces carried out 47 drone strikes that killed 94 civilians between April and August, up from 22 strikes that killed 44 civilians a year earlier .
